description: React component for an announcement bar with customizable styles, tooltip, and close functionality, used in Mattermost web application.

classes.name: AnnouncementBar
classes.description: A React component that displays an announcement bar with various customizable options, including message, style, icon, tooltip, and close button.

methods.name: enableToolTipIfNeeded
methods.description: Enables tooltip if the message text overflows its container.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Increments announcement bar count and sets CSS variable for height calculation.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Updates CSS variable if announcement bar count changes.

methods.name: componentWillUnmount
methods.description: Decrements announcement bar count and cleans up CSS classes and variables.

methods.name: handleClose
methods.description: Handles the close button click event to dismiss the announcement bar.
